annotations.title: Días hábiles en Colombia entre fechas

description:
Cuenta días hábiles entre dos fechas en Colombia, excluyendo domingos, sábados (opcional) y festivos nacionales. Cuándo: hay que aplicar con exactitud una regla colombiana (DIAN, festivos de la Ley Emiliani, montos en COP, IVA, GMF, UVT), p. ej. al facturar o cobrar. No para: contar días hábiles entre dos fechas, excluyendo fines de semana configurables y festivos (business-days-between). Efectos secundarios: ninguno (solo lectura, sin red, sin estado guardado). Determinista: la misma entrada da la misma salida. Límites: entrada JSON de hasta 64 KB, 1 s por llamada, resultado de hasta 1 MB.

EN: Counts business days (días hábiles) between two dates in Colombia, excluding Sundays, Saturdays (unless saturday_is_business) and national holidays; lists holidays skipped. When: a Colombian rule (DIAN, Ley Emiliani holidays, COP amounts, IVA, GMF, UVT) has to be applied exactly, e.g. in invoicing or payment flows. [EN completo / full EN: inputSchema.description]

inputSchema.description: EN: Counts business days (días hábiles) between two dates in Colombia, excluding Sundays, Saturdays (unless saturday_is_business) and national holidays; lists holidays skipped. When: a Colombian rule (DIAN, Ley Emiliani holidays, COP amounts, IVA, GMF, UVT) has to be applied exactly, e.g. in invoicing or payment flows. Not for: counting working days between two dates, excluding configurable weekend days and a list of holidays (business-days-between). Side effects: none (read-only, no network access, no stored state). Deterministic: the same input gives the same output. Limits: JSON input up to 64 KB, 1 s per call, result up to 1 MB.

end.description: End YYYY-MM-DD (string; required; up to 10 chars; format date).

inclusive.description: Count the start date too (boolean; optional; default false).

saturday_is_business.description: Saturday counts as business day (boolean; optional; default false).

start.description: Start YYYY-MM-DD (string; required; up to 10 chars; format date).
